task: Who wrote the novel 1984 and when was it published and what other notable works did the author write?

steps.observation:
Page: Nineteen Eighty-Four
Summary: Nineteen Eighty-Four is a dystopian speculative fiction novel by the English writer George Orwell. It was published on 8 June 1949 by Secker & Warburg as Orwell's ninth and final completed book. Thematically, it centres on totalitarianism, mass surveillance and repressive regimentation of people and behaviours. Nineteen Eighty-Four has been often regarded as a classic and has been acknowledged for its impact on twentieth-century literature.

final_answer: The author of the novel "1984" is George Orwell, and it was published on June 8, 1949. George Orwell wrote several other notable works, including "Animal Farm" and "Brave New World" is not written by him but "Burmese Days", "A Clergyman's Daughter", "Keep the Aspidistra Flying", "Coming Up for Air", "The Lion and the Unicorn", "The Road to Wigan Pier" and "Homage to Catalonia".
